comparisons.reason: Same source (OC_comments) and any/binary/null rules, but the constructs differ in breadth. Left counts only a specific functioning institutional precedent (existing law, policy, court, organization or system that operates or has operated). Right counts any concrete real-world example, including events, persons, statistic-bearing situations and personal experiences. Right is materially broader, so a personal anecdote or a historical event would score 1 on right but 0 on left.
